title: The PCs' exploration activities (saves/<campaign>/exploration.json)
description: What each PC keeps doing while the party travels (board/explore.js): an activity from the system's exploration rules (system.exploration) with its choices, or a note. On the board each is a record explore/<token id>.

activity.description: an activity id from the system's list; null: just travelling

options.description: the activity's choices: who is followed, a skill, a spell

note.description: what the character does, in words (systems without exploration rules)
